items.title: Pensions dashboard targeted for summer 2027 launch
items.summary: The pensions minister has confirmed that the MoneyHelper Pensions Dashboard is expected to become publicly available in summer 2027.

items.title: FCA issues warning over citiprimecorporate.com clone firm
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has warned the public against dealing with citiprimecorporate.com, an unauthorised clone of genuine firm Citibank, N.A.

items.title: Insurance AI spend climbs as measurable returns lag behind
items.summary: Nearly two-thirds of insurance chief executives plan to direct 11% to 20% of their budgets to artificial intelligence over the next year, while only 1% report measurable returns.

items.title: Pension administration regulation challenges likely to fall on The Pensions Regulator
items.summary: Trafalgar House suggests the main test for incoming administration rules will be the regulator's own resources and enforcement capabilities.

items.title: Cyberattack methods outpace standard cyber insurance renewal questionnaires
items.summary: A Beazley Security report reveals modern ransomware techniques bypass basic multi-factor authentication checks, creating hidden coverage gaps for policyholders.

items.title: Poll signals further MGA expansion in Europe next year
items.summary: Research from MGA incubator DA Strategy indicates that one in five London market managing general agents plan to enter continental Europe over the next one to two years.
